renderError.body: The app hit a render error. Copy the report from the dialog and paste it into <mono>#patchman-support</mono>, then reload to continue.

scopePicker.localAvailable: Run on this machine. Required for 127.0.0.1 / LAN endpoints.
scopePicker.localUnavailable: Not available — this connection wasn't written to the local BE. Edit + Save to retry.
scopePicker.remoteAvailable: Run on the PatchMan server. Consistent with teammates / prod behind the server network.
scopePicker.remoteUnavailable: Not available — this connection wasn't written to the team BE. Edit + Save to retry.
scopePicker.tooltip: Which backend runs this {{noun}} — your local desktop BE or the team server.

dbBanner.blockedTitle: Another tab is blocking the upgrade
dbBanner.blockedBody: Another tab of this app is still running the old schema. Close the other tabs, come back here, and reload the page.
dbBanner.incompatibleTitle: Local database is incompatible with the new schema
dbBanner.incompatibleBody: IndexedDB holds an older version that could not be upgraded. Resetting the local database fixes it, but any local changes that have not been synced will be deleted.
dbBanner.openFailedTitle: Could not open the local database
dbBanner.openFailedBody: IndexedDB failed to open. Try reloading the page; if the problem persists you can reset the local database (unsynced local changes will be deleted).

errorReport.title: Something went wrong
errorReport.description: {{source}} — the app may still be usable, but please report this so we can fix it.
errorReport.forwarded: This error has been forwarded to the team automatically. Copy the report below and paste it into <mono>{{channel}}</mono> if you'd like to add context.
errorReport.resetHint: If the same error keeps coming back on every launch, you can reset your local session. This only clears the data cached on this device — your remote workspaces, collections, and other data are not affected. You may need to sign in again.

connect.title: Connect to your backend
connect.description: PatchMan needs a backend to sign in and sync your data. Enter your backend URL, or continue offline.
connect.offlineHint: Offline mode uses only this device — no account, no sync.
connect.unreachable: Couldn’t reach that backend. Check the URL and try again.
connect.notPatchman: That URL isn’t a PatchMan backend.
connect.incompatibleAppOld: This backend needs a newer version of the app. Please update PatchMan.
connect.incompatibleBackendOld: This backend is too old for this app. Ask an admin to update it.
connect.incompatibleDescription: The current backend isn’t compatible with this version of the app. Connect a compatible backend, or continue offline.
connect.switchedNotice: Switched from {{from}} to {{to}} — the previous backend isn’t compatible with this app version.
